title: Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes
abstract: arXiv:2611.08439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Typed-decision models score options that the caller supplies at request time, so their accuracy depends on label wording that the model's developer does not control. We compare two releases of a 307M-parameter multilingual cross-encoder, Ru-Jev, trained on thirteen Russian-language tasks; the later release adds an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms. Holding questions fixed and varying only how eighteen routing labels are worded, we evaluate ten label vocabularies, produced by three separate processes and checked for overlap with the training data, with five candidates per question and, for eight of them, also with eighteen. On held-out vocabularies made of ordinary or borrowed words (English-derived jargon, office slang, department names), the augmented release is more accurate in every setting, by up to 0.24. translated_title: 类型化决策编码器中的标签措辞增强：对不熟悉的词语有效，对缩写或代号无效
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型会对调用方在请求时提供的选项进行评分，因此其准确性取决于模型开发者无法控制的标签措辞。我们比较了 Ru-Jev 的两个版本——这是一个在十三项俄语任务上训练的 3.07 亿参数多语言交叉编码器；后一版本增加了一种增强方法，将标签以多种表面形式呈现。在保持问题不变、仅改变十八个路由标签措辞的条件下，我们评估了十套标签词汇表，这些词汇表由三种独立流程生成，并检查了与训练数据的重合情况；每题使用五个候选标签，其中八套词汇表还使用了十八个候选标签进行评估。在由普通词汇或外来词（源自英语的行话、办公室俚语、部门名称）构成的保留词汇表上，增强版本在所有设置下都更加准确，提升幅度最高达 0.24。这十四项增益中有十一项在 Holm 校正后仍然显著（十八个候选标签的俚语以及描述性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文对俄语类型化决策交叉编码器 Ru-Jev 引入标签多形式措辞增强，发现该增强对由普通词和外来词构成的标签词汇表能带来一致的准确性提升（最高达 0.24），但对缩写和代号类标签没有增益。
en_tdlr: A label surface-form augmentation in the Ru-Jev typed-decision cross-encoder consistently improves accuracy on held-out vocabularies of ordinary and borrowed words (by up to 0.24), but yields no gains for abbreviations or codes.
